hero.headline: I cross the BC–WA border weekly. Let me bring things for you.
hero.subtext: I commute between British Columbia and Washington State. I can buy or carry items across the border at a reasonable fee.

services.title: Services
services.buy_desc: I purchase on my credit card in the US — minimal or even free fee depending on item size and value (I earn points)
services.carry_desc: You buy it and ship to my WA address — I carry it across for a reasonable fee

pricing.title: Pricing & Important Notes
pricing.rule1: ~20% of the US/CA price difference as a reference — not fixed, depends on item size and value
pricing.rule2: Larger packages cost more; oversized items (> car trunk) not accepted
pricing.rule3: Buy for Me: minimal or even free — depends on item size and value. I earn credit card points, and if the package is delivered to my door and gets lost, my insurance covers it (may take some time)
pricing.rule4: Carry for Me: standard carrying fee — note that if a package is left at the door unattended and gets stolen, I am not responsible
pricing.rule5: Final price confirmed after reviewing your request via your contact
pricing.rule6: If I buy it, I generally don't need to open the packaging. If you ship it to me, I may need to open and inspect it — I can't carry anything illegal
pricing.rule7: If you buy it yourself: pay the fee upon delivery. If I buy it for you: a 20% deposit of the item price is required upfront

how.title: How It Works
how.step1_desc: Fill out the form below with what you need
how.step2_desc: I'll review and reply via your contact with a quote
how.step3_desc: Your item arrives on my next border crossing

form.title: Submit a Request
form.service_carry: Carry for Me (I already purchased it)
form.item_link_placeholder: Amazon or other shopping site URL
form.image_drop_hint: Click to select or drag image here
form.size_large_error: Sorry, we don't accept oversized items.
form.success: Your request has been received. I'll follow up via your provided contact.
